name: CLOBETASOL 0.044/100GR CREAM 40GR
description: Clobetasol cream (0.044 g/100 g) in a 40-gram tube is a high-potency corticosteroid. It is used to treat severe dermatological conditions that have not responded adequately to other, less potent steroids. If discomfort persists, consult your doctor.
